quote:
When a door stays shut while flame encroaches, the fire consumes the very trust it guarded.  

When a heart cannot be contained within a plane's cabin, destiny lifts its wings and lets it fall.  

A missile striking an ally’s dawn reminds us that true strength often lies in the pause before the echo.  

Twenty‑five years of hidden images ripple into the present, proof that the past can still chill our modern waters.  

A revision of a throne shows that form only endures when the fabric of consensus
